replaces: internal no-GT-first-frame reproduction numbers previously used as thresholds

source.paper: Interact2Ar: Full-Body Human-Human Interaction Generation via Autoregressive Diffusion Models, arXiv:2512.19692v2
source.conditioning_caveat: Paper numbers use a ground-truth first-frame condition; HHC headline comparison must disclose and match this condition before claiming fair superiority.

direction.MModality: higher_as_table_arrow; also report jointly with MM_Dist because the paper notes that lower MModality can accompany better text alignment
direction.PJ: closer_to_ground_truth (the Interact2Ar table prints an up arrow, but the cited FlowMDM definition and source paper use a right arrow)

acceptance.headline: HHC must beat the Interact2Ar autoregressive row on R-precision, FID, MM Dist, Diversity and MModality for all three joint evaluators under the paper protocol; Diversity is judged by absolute distance to the corresponding GT Diversity rather than unbounded increase.

transition_metrics_are_separate.paper_protocol: 64 sequences, each concatenating 8 motions; PJ/AUJ are computed over complete composed sequences
transition_metrics_are_separate.reason_not_in_joint_generation_gate: They are not computed from the ordinary 1696-sample test generations and the released Interact2Ar evaluate.py does not implement them.
transition_metrics_are_separate.status: not silently claimed by the joint evaluator gate
